title: Command Repeater
description: Adds a new menu to the game where you can repeat commands with insane paces. The default keybind is M and can be changed.
body: Command Repeater adds a new menu that allows you to repeat commands with delays. This handy if u for example need to run a command 100 times. You can just set a delay of how many seconds you want between the commands and press M to stop it again. M can be changed in Keybinds.
